name: fusai-dashboard-aig

scripts.dev: node --eval "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
